source.name: Genoa CFC, 'Pulsee Luce e Gas e Genoa CFC: con l'energia di casa, uno sconto fino al 100% per la maglia ufficiale KOMBAT™'
source.quote: Pulsee Luce e Gas – Front Jersey Sponsor del Genoa– lancia una speciale operazione
source.note: The club's own press release, restating Pulsee's role for the 2026/27 season. The club's partner page lists Pulsee as 'Front Jersey Sponsor' (genoacfc.it/partner/), and the club-shop product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt shows Pulsee Luce e Gas across the chest.

source.name: Genoa CFC, 'bet365 Scores è lo Sleeve Sponsor'
source.quote: bet365 Scores è il nuovo Sleeve Sponsor per le stagioni sportive 2026/27 e 2027/28 in relazione alla prima squadra maschile
source.note: The club's announcement: the bet365 Scores logo goes on the left sleeve ('maniche sinistre') of the first-team shirts, with the deal brokered by Infront Sports. The club-shop product photo of the 2026/27 home shirt shows the bet365 Scores logo on the sleeve.

source.name: Genoa CFC, 'Genoa Home Kit 2026/27: You'll never run alone'
source.note: Kit maker (technical sponsor), not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The club's kit launch describes the KOMBAT™ Pro shirt 'ideata da Genoa e Kappa'; the club's partner page lists Kappa as 'Technical Sponsor'.
source.quote: ideata da Genoa e Kappa con la partecipazione di No Panic Agency

summary: Kappa home shirt with a 1990s-style red-and-blue split: Pulsee Luce e Gas on the front, bet365 Scores on the left sleeve (new from July 2026, running through 2027/28). The club's launch photos and shop product photos show no back or shorts sponsor. Pulsee is the domestic retail brand of Axpo Italia, part of Switzerland's state-owned Axpo Group; bet365 Scores is bet365's live-scores app, controlled by the Coates family; Kappa is a BasicNet brand.
